statements.label: supported
statements.text: Expressing either Drosophila gypsy (mdg4-ERV) or human HERV-K (HML-2) was individually sufficient to drive cytoplasmic aggregation of human TDP-43.
statements.evidence: Expression of either Drosophila mdg4-ERV (gypsy) or the human ERV, HERV-K (HML-2) are each sufficient to stimulate cytoplasmic aggregation of human TDP-43.
statements.note: The abstract states each ERV alone could trigger cytoplasmic TDP-43 aggregation.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Transmitted viral ERV induced TDP-43 pathology in recipient cells carrying physiological TDP-43 levels, whether neighbouring or distant.
statements.evidence: Viral ERV transmission also triggers TDP-43 pathology in recipient cells that express physiological levels of TDP-43, whether they are in contact or at a distance.
statements.note: This restates the result that ERV transmission spreads TDP-43 pathology to recipient cells near and far.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Antiretroviral drugs that block HERV-K slow motor decline in people with ALS.
statements.evidence: This mechanism potentially underlies the TDP-43 proteinopathy-caused neurodegenerative propagation through neuronal tissue.
statements.note: The abstract proposes a mechanism but never tests any antiretroviral treatment or clinical outcome.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Endogenous retrovirus expression and TDP-43 proteinopathy were found to reinforce one another.
statements.evidence: We demonstrate that endogenous retrovirus (ERV) expression and TDP-43 proteinopathy are mutually reinforcing.
statements.note: The abstract reports the two are mutually reinforcing.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: OBOX4 selectively binds and activates MERVL long terminal repeats plus a subset of MERVK LTRs.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Obox4 encodes a transcription factor abundantly expressed in mouse two-cell embryos that redundantly drives zygotic genome activation.

statements.text: In colorectal cancer and other epithelial tumors, oncogenic MAPK/AP1 signaling drives activation of LTR10-derived enhancers.

statements.label: supported

statements.label: supported

statements.label: supported
